dimensions.label: Regime & resilience
dimensions.forecast: W40 remains a volatile consolidation/retest regime; recovery structure survives without a confirmed market breakdown.
dimensions.hit_if: Weekly evidence supports consolidation/retest with recovery structure intact and no confirmed breakdown.
dimensions.mixed_if: Recovery structure survives but regime evidence is materially conflicted or a deeper breakdown scare occurs without confirmed weekly breakdown.
dimensions.miss_if: The week resolves into a confirmed breakdown or a materially different regime than recovery/consolidation.

dimensions.label: Leadership
dimensions.forecast: ETH relative leadership remains unstable rather than establishing a durable weekly leadership advance versus BTC.
dimensions.hit_if: ETH/BTC and corroborating relative-strength evidence fail to establish durable ETH leadership through the week.
dimensions.mixed_if: ETH leadership improves materially but is not persistent/confirmed across the week.
dimensions.miss_if: ETH establishes durable, persistent relative leadership versus BTC with corroborating evidence.

dimensions.label: Rotation / transmission
dimensions.forecast: Rotation remains concentrated in ETH/large caps; no sustained handoff into mid, small and micro caps is confirmed.
dimensions.hit_if: Any rotation remains selective/large-cap concentrated and no durable handoff into lower market-cap cohorts is confirmed.
dimensions.mixed_if: Transmission reaches another cohort but is partial, short-lived or internally inconsistent.
dimensions.miss_if: A sustained multi-layer handoff into mid/small/micro cohorts is confirmed.

dimensions.label: Breadth & persistence
dimensions.forecast: Participation may broaden intermittently, but persistent broad-altseason breadth is not confirmed.
dimensions.hit_if: Breadth remains selective/intermittent and does not persist broadly enough for altseason confirmation.
dimensions.mixed_if: Breadth broadens materially but persistence or confirmation remains incomplete.
dimensions.miss_if: Broad participation becomes persistent and confirms broad altseason conditions.

dimensions.label: Flow quality / fragility
dimensions.forecast: Price recovery remains stronger than underlying confirmation; breadth and spot/microstructure lag, while positive flow evidence provides counter-support.
dimensions.hit_if: Price/recovery holds better than internal breadth and spot/microstructure confirmation, with positive flow/counterevidence preventing a clean bearish structural break.
dimensions.mixed_if: Internal confirmation improves or deteriorates enough to weaken the fragile-recovery thesis, but evidence remains two-sided.
dimensions.miss_if: Underlying confirmation becomes decisively strong and broad, or flow/microstructure deteriorates into a confirmed bearish structural break.

invariants: Five permanent dimensions only and always in the same order.
One dimension, one vote; correlated evidence never creates extra votes.
Resolution criteria are frozen before scoring and cannot move after outcomes are known.
Market/Structure remains separate from Price Ranges.
Public calls synthesize canonical evidence; they are not single-chart observations.
